proposals.title: Self-hosting inauguration
proposals.summary: The org-os repo adopts org-os as its own operating system. Stubs filled with real content; instance-orchestration layer introduced (data/instances.yaml, skills-matrix.yaml, packages-matrix.yaml). Solo → OSS → DAO trajectory documented in IDENTITY.md.

proposals.title: Projects-vs-plans separation
proposals.summary: data/projects.yaml holds long-lived workstreams; docs/agent-plans/ holds specific plans. Plans reference parent workstream via `workstream:` frontmatter.
